Summarise a numeric variable without small or dominated groups

safe_summary.Rd

Gives the number of persons and chosen statistics of value for every group of by. A group with fewer than min_count persons has all its statistics suppressed. Means, sums and standard deviations are also suppressed where one or two persons dominate the group by the rules in check_dominance(): the mean income of a settlement where one person earns most of the money is close to that person's income.

Usage

safe_summary(
  data,
  value,
  by = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  stats = c("mean", "sd", "median"),
  config = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, for example one of the tables in the script.

value

Name of the numeric column to summarise. Missing values are left out, and persons are counted among the rows with a value.

by

Names of the columns to group by; NULL for one row for all.

id

Person identifier. Persons are counted, and for the dominance rules each person's values are added up first. Without id each row is one person.

stats

Statistics to give: any of "mean", "sd", "median", "p25", "p75" and "sum".

config

A mimic_config(); NULL uses the rules staff gave trial_run() or real_run(), see safe_output.

Value

A data frame with the by columns, n (rounded number of persons, NA when the group is too small) and one column per statistic, NA where suppressed. A message says how many groups were suppressed.

Details

Minimum and maximum are not offered: they almost always belong to one person. Use the quartiles (p25, p75) or the median instead.

Statistics are not rounded; the number of persons is rounded to round_base. Column names are mean_<value>, median_<value> and so on, which inspect() matches to the variable when it checks dominance on the real data.

See also

Other safe output: describe_output(), safe_count(), safe_model()

Examples

safe_summary(fake_persons, "income", by = "sex")
#>   sex   n mean_income sd_income median_income
#> 1   F 960    282416.3  179948.3        237100
#> 2   M 980    303660.0  372472.7        237700
safe_summary(fake_persons, "income", by = "settlement", stats = c("median", "p25", "p75"))
#> Suppressed 5 groups with fewer than 5 persons.
